meta.title: WordPress Projects Kerala | Teknoppy Portfolio
meta.description: Custom WordPress builds and platform migrations by Teknoppy, including multilingual sites and moves off outdated platforms without losing search rankings.

body.html: Custom WordPress builds and migrations from Teknoppy — including sites moved off outdated platforms without losing existing rankings, traffic or years of published content. None of these are off-the-shelf themes: each was built so the client's own team could publish to it without calling a developer, which matters more a year after launch than it does at handover.

sections.intro: The services these builds draw on, each with its own page.

items.title: Custom WordPress Development
items.text: Bespoke themes and functionality built to the brief, rather than a purchased theme bent into shape.

items.title: WordPress Migration
items.text: Moves off Wix, Blogger, static HTML and outdated WordPress installs, with redirects mapped so existing rankings survive the switch.

items.title: WordPress Speed Optimization
items.text: Core Web Vitals work on existing WordPress sites — image weight, render-blocking assets, caching and hosting configuration.

items.title: WordPress Maintenance
items.text: Ongoing updates, backups, uptime monitoring and security patching after launch.

paragraphs.html: Both projects above were delivered as full WordPress development engagements, with UI/UX design done before a line of theme code was written. Where a client already had a WordPress site, the work started as WordPress web design on the existing install instead of a rebuild.
Rankings and traffic figures for these builds are documented on Case Studies. For the wider portfolio, see all project categories.

items.q: Can Teknoppy move my existing site to WordPress without losing rankings?
items.a: Yes. Migrations are planned around a redirect map so existing URLs, rankings and traffic carry across.
items.aHtml: Yes. Migrations are planned around a redirect map so existing URLs, rankings and traffic carry across — see WordPress Migration Services.

items.q: Do you build custom themes or use pre-made ones?
items.a: Custom. Each build above uses a theme written for that client, so the site's structure matches their content rather than the other way round.

items.q: Can my team update the site after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every WordPress build here hands over an editing setup the client's own team uses without developer help, and ongoing maintenance is available separately.
